# `request-body-became-required`

Request body became required

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `request-body-became-required` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Request bodies ([RULES.md section 5](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An optional request body is now required.

## Why this default

Clients that sent no body are rejected.

## Example

From test case [`request-body-became-required`](../../test/cases/request-body-became-required/): Optional → required.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        operationId: createPet
        requestBody:
+         required: true
          content:
            application/json:
```

Findings:

- `request-body-became-required` · error · POST /pets

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  request-body-became-required: error
```

## How to fix

Keep the body optional.
